sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bruel's text is not in this scan: pp. 111-125 of the 1911 volume are book reviews. The volume does contain Ouzilleau, 'Notes sur la langue des pygmées de la Sanga' (pp. ~76-92), which mentions the 'Bumuali de Ouesso' only as a Fang-related tribe and gives no Bomwali data and nothing on stress. Vol. 1 (1910), with Bruel pp. 3-32, is not on archive.org; Gallica and HathiTrust were blocked.
